problem: Many installed Skills crowd context, repeated activations waste tokens, and compaction loses active versions.
principle: Disclose catalog, instructions and resources separately; deduplicate within the task session. Distinguish storage integrity reads from actual model context and from code execution.
solutions: Evaluate intent selection; avoid keyword-only claims
check: Does reading files during discovery mean all body tokens enter context?
answer: No. Disk reads, integrity verification and model-context injection differ. The example budgets characters, not measured tokens.
scope: Based on Agent Skills format; version pins, bundle digests and tool bindings are example Host conventions, not execution authority.
